groups.name: Hero image darkening overlay
groups.definition: Does the hero photo have a darkening overlay or gradient behind the heading text?

groups.name: Hero photos lack tint overlay
groups.definition: Do hero photos appear in near-natural color without a flat duotone or tint overlay?

groups.name: Images cropped to uniform small sizes
groups.definition: Are images or thumbnails cropped via object-fit to uniform small sizes, sometimes cutting off subjects?

groups.name: Placeholder image reused across cards
groups.definition: Is one placeholder image repeated across gallery, product or card items?

groups.name: Colored tiles replace photography
groups.definition: Are photos replaced by solid-color, pastel or gradient block tiles with text or icons?

groups.name: Icons are inline SVG
groups.definition: Are icons inline SVG elements rather than icon fonts?

groups.name: Icons absent, text labels used
groups.definition: Are utility actions shown as plain text labels with no SVG icons?

groups.name: Images with rounded corners and shadow
groups.definition: Do images have rounded corners and/or drop shadows, including arch or curved crops?

groups.name: Slogan graphic in shadowed card
groups.definition: Is a standalone slogan graphic shown small inside a white shadowed card?

groups.name: Small circular avatar
groups.definition: Is there a small circular avatar next to a name and subtitle?

groups.name: All images load without breakage
groups.definition: Do all images load with valid sizes, with no broken images or icon-font glyph failures?

groups.name: Descriptive alt text, empty on decorative
groups.definition: Do meaningful images have descriptive alt text while decorative icons have empty alt?

groups.name: Small left-aligned logo or sponsor strip
groups.definition: Are sponsor or partner logos small, uniformly sized and left-aligned in a strip?

groups.name: Header logo legible size
groups.definition: Is the logo displayed at a clearly legible size in the header?

groups.name: Text-only cards without imagery
groups.definition: Are cards or product items text-only with no images, or sparse imagery overall?

groups.name: Distorted scaled-down images
groups.definition: Are small images scaled so their aspect ratio is distorted?

groups.name: Media embeds replaced by link cards
groups.definition: Are video or media embeds replaced with text-link cards?

groups.name: Grey no-preview placeholder
groups.definition: Do missing images show a grey 'No preview available' placeholder rather than a broken image?

groups.name: Full-bleed hero photograph
groups.definition: Is there a large full-bleed hero or team photograph as an img element?

groups.name: Icons uniform small squares in cards
groups.definition: Are icons normalized to a uniform small square size inside cards?
